name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: A dark block that prints source code with numbered lines and colour highlighting, a filename row with a copy icon, and optional file tabs for switching between snippets.
use: Docs, changelogs or a portfolio need to show a short snippet with a copy button and file context.
avoid: Very long files: the panel has no scroll cap, so tall code stretches the whole page.
a11y: The icon-only copy button has no label and tabs never announce which one is selected. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rounded slate-black panels stack with a small gap, each holding numbered lines of code in soft yellow, blue and white monospace. The upper panel shows a filename and a small copy icon; the lower one shows two file tabs.
behaves: Clicking a file tab swaps the code in the panel, one tab turning white and the other grey. Clicking the copy icon copies the visible snippet and swaps it for a tick for two seconds.
customise: Set language, filename, code and line highlights as props, or pass a tabs array for several files; colours and font come from a bundled theme and the source.
weight: light: The snippet is coloured once per tab switch and no animation loop runs.
